Subject: Missed MAP checkpoint — rebook and milestone reprioritization

Hi Rachel —

We missed our 9 AM MAP checkpoint this morning; hope everything is OK on your side. I wanted to follow up quickly with a proposed path forward so we can keep momentum without losing runway on the pilot dates.

Quick summary / ask:
- Please pick one of the proposed slots below for a 30–45 minute catch-up and re-alignment on milestones.
  • Tue 1/12, 11:00–11:30 PT
  • Wed 1/13, 09:30–10:00 PT
  • Thu 1/14, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Confirm whether Chris (cc’d on this thread) should be included for the rebook.
- We’ve reprioritized the MAP to keep the pilot scope tight; I attached Orchard_MAP_v2.xlsx and a short summary PDF with the timeline changes. Key change: pilot kickoff moves from 01/31 -> 02/14 to allow the shortened scope to be validated.

If none of those times work, share two windows that do and we’ll book. Ben (Solutions Eng) will join to walk the technical checklist. Marissa (CS) is cc’d to note the timeline shift for onboarding resources.

Thanks — would love to lock a time today so we can update the project plan and notify stakeholders.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Sofia —

So sorry — an urgent clinical meeting ran long and I couldn't get out in time. Thank you for reaching out and for the updated MAP.

We can do Wed 1/13 09:30–10:00 PT for a 30-minute sync. I’ll bring Chris; he’ll want to confirm the pilot data scope. Can Ben keep the call to 30 minutes and focus on the checklist and deployment blockers?

If you can send a calendar invite and a short agenda (3 bullets), I’ll accept.

Apologies again, and appreciate the flexibility.

— Rachel
Rachel Lin

rachel@orchardhealth.com

- Deliverable order rearranged to validate ingestion and metrics before UI integration.
